t: 圣殿骑士团第23任也是最后一位外公雅克·德·莫莱被活活活烧死.
te: Jacques de Molay, the 23rd and final Grand Master of the Knights Templar, is burned at the stake.
dz: 圣殿骑士团第23任也是最后一位外公雅克·德·莫莱被活活活烧死.
de: Jacques de Molay, the 23rd and final Grand Master of the Knights Templar, is burned at the stake.

t: 班诺克本战役(斯德林以南)开始.
te: The Battle of Bannockburn (south of Stirling) begins.
dz: 第一次苏格兰独立战争:班诺克本战役(斯德林以南)开始.
de: First War of Scottish Independence: The Battle of Bannockburn (south of Stirling) begins.

t: 班诺克本之战以由布鲁斯人罗伯特所领导的苏格兰军队的决定性胜利而告终.
te: The Battle of Bannockburn concludes with a decisive victory by Scottish forces led by Robert the Bruce.
dz: 第一次苏格兰独立战争:班诺克本之战以由布鲁斯人罗伯特所领导的苏格兰军队的决定性胜利而告终.
de: First War of Scottish Independence: The Battle of Bannockburn concludes with a decisive victory by Scottish forces led by Robert the Bruce.

t: 国王哈康五世将挪威首都从卑尔根迁至奥斯陆。
te: King Haakon V moves the capital of Norway from Bergen to Oslo.
dz: 国王哈康五世将挪威首都从卑尔根迁至奥斯陆。
de: King Haakon V moves the capital of Norway from Bergen to Oslo.
